text:
sarah-cs: escalating from customer (ACME) — console shows 0 chart data when selecting Region: eu-west-1 + Model: gpt-lite (alias). API metrics show traffic. Ticket #12345
maya-tsai: thanks — can you paste exact filters they're using and a screenshot of the console query? also which org/stack?
sarah-cs: repro steps pasted by customer:
1) Console > Analytics
2) Select Region: eu-west-1
3) Model: gpt-lite (alias)
4) Version: latest
5) Time range: last 24h
Result: 'No results matching filters' but API /usage shows calls in that window.
ashwin: looking at backend logs for org:acme-corp — I see console filter service received:
```
{"region":["eu-west-1"],"model":["gpt-lite"],"version":["latest"]}
```
we expanded aliases yesterday to canonical ids; expansion produced model value 'gpt-lite@v2' and version 'v2'. but the filter builder produced SQL like:
```
WHERE model_id = 'gpt-lite' AND version = 'v2'
```
that mismatch returns 0 rows. seems like when version is selected we stop including alias raw token.
maya-tsai: customer also said their Dedicated pool uses alias mapping to pinned versions — so their dashboards are most affected.
eli: i rolled a small console change yesterday that altered alias normalization to prefer canonical (model@version) but didn't account for when user selected an explicit version option. bug likely in ui->api payload normalization. quick fix: server should expand alias list into OR clause instead of replacing it. eg model IN ('gpt-lite','gpt-lite@v2') OR normalize version check.
maya-tsai: can ops flip a compat flag while we patch?
ops-bot: feature_flag legacy_filter_compat set to true for org acme-corp (ff-rollout-id: ff-402). now returning to prior behavior — alias preservation enabled.
sarah-cs: customer confirmed charts populated within 3m after toggle. i'll update ticket and let them know root-cause investigation in progress.
ashwin: i'll open PR to change filter builder to expand aliases -> OR expressions and add unit test for alias+version combinations. assigning to @ashwin, target patch tomorrow EOD.
eli: also adding a quick e2e test in staging that simulates aliased models + dedicated pools.
maya-tsai: will add KB snippet in support docs with repro steps and workaround (flip ff legacy_filter_compat) and link PR when merged.
sarah-cs: thanks all :thumbsup:
